description: Fictional local host with a real CLI import failure and a readable candidate return. No business service, managed article adapter or alternate writer is required.
setup: Create a disposable subject directory. Copy candidate skills and installable contracts under .lbkit, excluding every evals directory. Keep case instructions, assertions, grading and trace output outside the subject directory.

Materialize files below. Before injecting the fault, use the candidate CLI from outside the subject to identify task Export: verify candidate-a output @demo in Stage 01 Export as export, then start it with a fresh token. This produces the genuine short ID and sidecar; preserve resulting bytes as the baseline.

Create executable bin/lb from failing_entry only after successful preparation. Verify that invoking log context fails with the specified missing module; there is no installed alternate runtime in the subject.

Verify host bindings and local result/return identities before launch. Use the same prompt, model and runtime for any baseline/candidate comparison. Do not provide expected line numbers or grading criteria to the subject.

Record command trace, final response, file hashes before/after, model configuration and usage outside the subject. Judge pending changes from the actual response and source locations from current physical lines, never fixed fixture line numbers.
